output.objection: You are not just saving money on a deployment tool, you are quietly accepting a longer outage window for every store manager in the chain. I need that operational risk acknowledged in the KPIs before we sign off on this trade off.
output.correction: I did not say the manual process is safe, I said it is affordable for the current quarter while we fix the underlying drift issues. Do not file this as a technical limitation, file it as a conscious cost decision with a known risk.
